name: Video Scene Summarizer
description: Detect scene changes in a video via ffmpeg and summarize each one with a vision-LLM call -- a table of contents for video, one row per scene (timestamp, frame, summary).

inputs.description: Input DataFrame with a column of video file paths.

outputs.description: One row per detected scene: video_id, source_video, scene_index, timestamp_seconds, frame_path, summary.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream DataFrame asset key providing video file paths.

video_id_column.label: Video Id Column
video_id_column.description: Optional column to carry forward as `video_id` on each scene row. Default: row index.

scene_threshold.label: Scene Threshold
scene_threshold.description: ffmpeg scene-change sensitivity (0-1). Lower catches more/subtler cuts; higher only catches hard cuts.

max_scenes_per_video.label: Max Scenes Per Video
max_scenes_per_video.description: Safety cap on scenes extracted (and summarized) per video.

output_dir.label: Output Directory
output_dir.description: Filesystem directory for extracted scene frames.

api_key_env_var.label: Api Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Environment variable holding the API key.

summary_prompt.label: Summary Prompt
summary_prompt.description: Instruction sent to the vision LLM alongside each scene frame.
summary_prompt.default: Describe what's happening in this video frame in one or two sentences. Be specific about action, setting, and any visible text.

llm_max_retries.label: LLM Max Retries
llm_max_retries.description: Retry a scene's LLM call this many times on transient errors before giving up on it.

ffmpeg_binary.label: Ffmpeg Binary
ffmpeg_binary.description: Path or name of the ffmpeg binary.

description.label: Description
description.description: Asset description shown in the Dagster catalog.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — team names or email addresses.

include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata
include_preview_metadata.description: Include a preview of the output data in metadata.

preview_rows.label: Preview Rows
preview_rows.description: Rows to include in the preview metadata when include_preview_metadata is True.

retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries
retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy.

freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag Minutes
freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before the asset is considered stale.

freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron
freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule string for the freshness policy.

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: Partition start date (ISO), required for time-based types.
